g.text: POST /api/ai-agents-teams/run/prepare + /send — invoke a deployed team, read back its run ledger
Phase 1 — prepare (mints the run capability; deploys nothing)
Sign and send — no finalization subscription
The send response is the observer readback, not
a deploy id: the caller sees the exact post-state
it acted on. There is nothing to subscribe on —
finality already happened inside send. Ongoing
inspection is GET /runs/{run_id}, whose URL is
the read capability minted at prepare.
